CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2465 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head afabd5b6a6e2da5bb42eaad5f6697837491c5556. Bus nonce: 0f1f8919bff09df03e399b56241f22ab. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin afabd5b6a6e2da5bb42eaad5f6697837491c5556`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge afabd5b6a6e2da5bb42eaad5f6697837491c5556` or `Fix review: blocked afabd5b6a6e2da5bb42eaad5f6697837491c5556 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 0f1f8919bff09df03e399b56241f22ab`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2465 afabd5b6a6e2da5bb42eaad5f6697837491c5556") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2465-0f1f8919`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 2 of R10-SETPOINT-BOOST. Round 1 (head 345cdf58) was blocked carry-missing: 3 unrouted body items. The fixer now routes 6 items as Carry: lines, to R10-CEILING-PROBE (real-maximum limitation, p_max owner question, idle-draw-absorbs-compressor note, and the defect 2b set-point-to-draw gain identification), R10-DEMAND-OVERBOOK (over-booking) and R10-BUFFER-STORE and R10-COP-PARTLOAD. All four groups are now on main's roster (roster PR #2467 merged dc84fd12), so carry_audit must route 6/6 with 0 bad destinations against origin/main; confirm that pr-contract is green. The fixer also pinned the round-1 reviewer's R16 survivor (removing lo=min(floor_c, heat_c) in _flow_target): a test-only commit adds a fractional-inlet check (25.3 and 25.9 C -> 31) with a whole-26 null, plus mutant M15. Check that M15 fails only that check, that M0 is 69 green, that M1-M14 are still red (M10 now has 3 failures), and that features is 4248. Production code is unchanged from 890fba05. Disclosed: the _SP_READ fixture change and a repairs.py disinfection write that goes up to 0.22 K low on F. Judge those. The flat-day relaxed-start figure differs by machine (0/16 vs 2/14); confirm that the body states both. Say which round this is. The owner's export is private.
